threat_event: Payroll platform account taken over through an adversary-in-the-middle phishing page; attacker exports the associate register and changes direct deposit accounts
threat_source: Cybercriminal group (payroll fraud and identity theft)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Payroll platform not on SSO; SMS one-time codes can be relayed; no alert on bulk export or bank changes
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02; associate PII (about 31,000 records); weekly payroll
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (SMS codes; no alert rules); EV-001 (payroll platform not in SSO); EV-052 (Payroll Manager interview)
existing_controls: Unique named accounts; SMS one-time codes
treatment_plan: Put the payroll platform behind SSO with number-matching push MFA; alerts on exports and bank changes; phishing training for payroll staff (see P08)

threat_event: Associate pay diverted by a fraudulent direct deposit change made through the associate portal or by a caller posing as an associate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank changes take effect next payroll with no out-of-band confirmation; payroll staff accept changes by phone
likelihood_basis: EV-006 (bank-change confirmation off); EV-052 (bank-change fraud calls in 2026)
existing_controls: Payroll Specialists compare names on the account
treatment_plan: Call-back to the phone number on file before any bank change; 1-payroll hold on new accounts; no phone or email bank changes

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by phishing encrypts laptops and the cloud workloads
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: EDR alerts reviewed next business day; flat branch networks; kiosks on staff network
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (phishing tickets); EV-012 (next-business-day alert review); EV-014 (kiosks on staff network)
existing_controls: EDR on laptops; automatic patching; laptop encryption
treatment_plan: 24x7 EDR monitoring by the managed IT provider; separate kiosk and guest networks; phishing exercises

threat_event: Backups of the reporting database and document archive deleted or encrypted along with production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Snapshots in the same account and region; same admin roles; never restore-tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 backup vault; scanned Form I-9 archive
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (snapshots in the same account and region; no restores); EV-018 (shared administrator roles)
treatment_plan: Separate backup account with immutable retention and second region; quarterly restore tests including the I-9 archive

threat_event: Bulk theft of SSNs and bank accounts from the reporting database through a recruiter account or insider query
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full SSNs and bank accounts copied nightly for reports that do not need them; all 22 recruiters can query
likelihood_basis: EV-021 (full SSNs and bank accounts; all recruiters can query)
existing_controls: SSO with MFA; provider encryption at rest
treatment_plan: Stop copying SSNs and bank accounts (keep last 4 digits); restrict database access to 3 report builders; query logging

threat_event: Recruiter opens I-9 document images and consumer reports of candidates with no job need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ATS roles let every recruiter see all branches' I-9 images and consumer report PDFs; no access review
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (recruiter role sees all branches); EV-052 (interviews)
treatment_plan: Split ATS roles so only Onboarding and Compliance Specialists see I-9 images and consumer reports; quarterly access review

threat_event: Former staff keep E-Verify access after leaving
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: E-Verify accounts outside SSO and not on the termination checklist
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (checklist omits E-Verify); EV-058 (2 departed users still active)
regulatory_driver: E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.3; Art. II.A.15
treatment_plan: Add E-Verify to the termination checklist; monthly reconciliation of E-Verify users to HR roster

threat_event: ICE inspection finds the electronic Form I-9 system does not meet the documentation and audit trail standards
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No description of the electronic I-9 system or indexing; no periodic checks; scanned archive has no access audit trail
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 I-9 module; SYS-04 document archive
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no I-9 system description or check records); EV-020 (archive data events off)
existing_controls: ATS module keeps change history per record
treatment_plan: Write the electronic I-9 system description; enable object-level access logging on the archive; quarterly sample check of 25 I-9s

threat_event: Forms I-9 cannot be produced within 3 business days of an inspection notice because the archive or ATS data is lost
threat_source: Hardware or service failure; vendor exit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Archive depends on untested snapshots; ATS contract has no data-return clause
likelihood_basis: EV-023 (untested snapshots); EV-036 (no ATS data-return clause)
treatment_plan: Quarterly export of the I-9 index and images to the immutable backup; data-return clause at ATS renewal

threat_event: Class action for a background check disclosure that is not a standalone document
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure form includes a liability release and state notices
likelihood_basis: EV-032 (disclosure page with release and state notices)
existing_controls: Screening provider template (modified by the firm in 2023)
treatment_plan: Replace with a disclosure-only form reviewed by counsel; separate authorization

threat_event: Candidate rejected on the basis of a consumer report without the pre-adverse action copy and summary of rights
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Recruiters can mark a candidate Not Eligible in the ATS without triggering the screening provider's pre-adverse workflow
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (Not Eligible status does not start the pre-adverse workflow; none found in 20 rejections)
existing_controls: Screening provider sends pre-adverse and adverse letters when triggered
treatment_plan: Lock the Not Eligible status to Onboarding and Compliance Specialists; monthly reconciliation of rejections to letters

threat_event: Consumer report information recovered from records or devices that were not properly disposed of
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Consumer report PDFs kept indefinitely; a kiosk PC discarded unwiped in 2025; laptop wipes not recorded
likelihood_basis: EV-013 (kiosk discarded unwiped; laptop wipes unrecorded); EV-022 (consumer reports kept with no purge)
existing_controls: Shred bins and shredding certificates for paper
treatment_plan: Retention schedule; certified device destruction with certificates; purge reports past retention

threat_event: AI screening tool ranks or auto-advances candidates in a way that disadvantages a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tool in auto-advance mode since 2026-03 with no bias testing, no notice, and no human review of lower-ranked applicants
likelihood_basis: EV-039 (auto-advance mode since 2026-03-02; no bias test); EV-052 (Director of Recruiting interview)
existing_controls: Recruiters see every applicant list (but work the ranked queue)
treatment_plan: Switch to sort-only mode; bias testing plan and quarterly monitoring (P10)

threat_event: Applicants with disabilities screened out by the AI tool or the online application without an accommodation path
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accommodation contact on the career site; tool parses resumes only
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (no accommodation contact); EV-051 (walk-in applications accepted)
treatment_plan: Accommodation notice and alternate application path on the career site (P10)

threat_event: Lobby applicant kiosk used to install a keylogger or reach staff systems
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kiosks on the staff network with a shared local account and no browser lockdown
likelihood_basis: EV-014 (kiosks on staff network); EV-055 (shared local account; browsing and USB allowed)
existing_controls: Kiosks in view of the front desk
treatment_plan: Move kiosks to an isolated network; kiosk mode browser; daily reset

threat_event: Business email compromise of an Account Manager mailbox used to send clients false payment instructions
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No external-sender warnings; no training on invoice fraud
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (no external-sender warning); EV-027 (training records); EV-028 (phishing tickets)
treatment_plan: Training; external sender tags; bank details on invoices confirmed by portal notice

threat_event: Attacker activity in the ATS or payroll platform goes unnoticed for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No audit log review or alerting; identity provider logs kept 30 days
likelihood_basis: EV-002 (sign-in logs kept 30 days); EV-007 (no scheduled report runs); EV-024 (no log review records)
existing_controls: Audit logs exist in each SaaS
treatment_plan: Weekly review of payroll exports, bank changes, and admin actions; 1-year log retention in the cloud log workspace

threat_event: Florida breach notices missed because no one owns the 30-day clock
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident response plan or notice procedure
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no incident response plan or notice procedure); EV-053 (HR and Compliance Manager interview)
treatment_plan: P08 runbook and notification matrix; tabletop exercise

threat_event: Payroll platform outage on payroll day delays pay for about 450 associates
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No manual payroll procedure; single payroll vendor
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no manual payroll procedure); EV-037 (vendor RTO 8 h)
treatment_plan: Manual off-cycle payroll procedure using the prior week's register; vendor RTO confirmed against the BIA

threat_event: ATS outage stops onboarding, E-Verify case creation within 3 business days, and timesheet approvals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No downtime procedure; single ATS
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no ATS downtime procedure); EV-051 (BIA interviews)
existing_controls: Paper Form I-9 available at branches
treatment_plan: Downtime kit: paper I-9 packets, E-Verify website direct use, paper timesheets

threat_event: Hurricane closes headquarters and branches for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contingency plan; payroll staff all at HQ
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no contingency plan); EV-003 (payroll team at HQ); EV-051 (BIA interviews)
existing_controls: SaaS systems reachable from anywhere; laptops
treatment_plan: Contingency plan with remote payroll run and branch relocation

threat_event: Integration service error creates associates with wrong pay rates or drops new hires from payroll
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No monitoring or reconciliation of the sync; single container
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (single container; no sync alerts); EV-052 (spot checks of large rate changes)
treatment_plan: Sync error alerts; weekly reconciliation report of new hires and rate changes

threat_event: Timekeeping vendor exposes associates' clock-in geolocation history
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Location history kept for the life of the account; no contract terms
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (location history kept for the life of the account); EV-036 (no contract terms)
treatment_plan: Set 13-month location retention; add security and breach notice terms at renewal

threat_event: Screening provider breach exposes consumer reports and SSNs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security review or breach notice terms beyond the statute
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (no security or breach notice terms)
existing_controls: Provider is an established consumer reporting agency
treatment_plan: Obtain the provider's SOC 2 or questionnaire; 72-hour notice term at renewal

threat_event: AI screening vendor reuses candidate data to train its models or suffers a breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No data processing terms; no security review before go-live
likelihood_basis: EV-039 (click-through terms; no data use commitments)
treatment_plan: Data use and security addendum with no-training clause (see P10)

threat_event: I-9 document photos or resumes emailed to the wrong recipient or to personal accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Candidates send document photos by email; no rule on where they may be kept
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (41 messages with document images); EV-052 (HR interview)
treatment_plan: Upload links in the ATS only; delete emailed copies; training

threat_event: Lost company smartphone exposes candidate texts and email
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Phones hold recruiter text threads
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (passcode, encryption and remote wipe on 34 smartphones)
existing_controls: Device management with passcode and remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Stolen laptop exposes cached candidate and associate files
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Laptops leave branches daily
likelihood_basis: EV-011 (full-disk encryption on 62 laptops)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: encryption takes the data outside the statute's personal information definition

threat_event: Cloud administrator account taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two administrators with standing access
likelihood_basis: EV-018 (2 administrators with standing rights); EV-002 (push MFA; managed device for administrators)
existing_controls: Number-matching push MFA; conditional access from managed devices only
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low; revisit with phishing-resistant MFA in 2027

threat_event: Denial of service against the career site
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Career site is vendor-hosted
likelihood_basis: EV-036 (vendor-hosted career site with DDoS protection); EV-051 (walk-in applications accepted)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the COO: residual risk Low

threat_event: Staff paste candidate or associate data into public generative AI chatbots
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No approved-tools list or AI use rule
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (staff report using public chatbots; no approved-tools list)
treatment_plan: Approved-tools list and AI rule in POL-05 (see P10)

threat_event: Impostor uses a stolen identity and manipulated video to pass a remote Form I-9 document examination
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote alternative procedure used for Office and Administrative hires; no liveness check or document retention review
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (9 remote hires; no written checklist)
regulatory_driver: N56-R03 (8 CFR 274a.2(b)(1)(ix)); E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.6
existing_controls: E-Verify photo matching for List A documents
treatment_plan: Remote exam checklist (same document shown on video, camera on, no filters); in-person exam when in doubt

threat_event: Client warehouse badges issued to associates are lost or not returned
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Badge log kept on a spreadsheet; returns not checked at assignment end
likelihood_basis: EV-044 (client badge log on a spreadsheet); EV-052 (Branch Managers interview)
treatment_plan: Badge return step in the assignment-end checklist; monthly badge reconciliation with each client

threat_event: Onboarding staff share a departed colleague's E-Verify login, so verification actions cannot be attributed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password known to colleague; E-Verify accounts outside SSO (found in P07 testing)
likelihood_basis: EV-IA-5 (shared E-Verify password found in P07 testing); EV-IA-2 (cases under a departed user ID)
regulatory_driver: E-Verify MOU Art. II.A.3; Art. II.A.15
treatment_plan: Deactivate both accounts; new named accounts with the E-Verify tutorial; attestation that credentials are not shared

threat_event: Florida Attorney General action after a breach because security measures were not reasonable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written program, risk assessment, or policies before 2026
likelihood_basis: EV-024 (no written program, risk assessment or policies before 2026)
treatment_plan: Adopt POL-01 to POL-05; annual risk assessment; keep evidence
